## Scope check

- [ ] It matches the linked issue - no drive-by features
- [ ] It does not violate the frozen MVP scope (PROPOSAL.md)

## Definition of Done

- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds
- [ ] Screenshot/GIF attached for UI changes
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior / tables / modules changed
- [ ] **No secrets** committed (`.env`, service keys, scraped personal data)
- [ ] RLS changes documented in [docs/rls.md](../docs/rls.md) and tested (screenshot of recipe run)
- [ ] Tests added where reasonable

## Notes for reviewers / mentors

Anything you want discussed before approval? Uncertainties, trade-offs, questions are all welcome.
